blocker_results.basis: Package-root, nested-working-directory, external-working-directory, and detached clean-extraction candidate invocations all returned PASS 23/23. Detached mode used frozen source_payload and produced no file or content changes.

Exact source-controlled relationships and JSON/CSV parity are enforced. Wrong-but-existing output and finding relationships, CSV divergence, and duplicate mapping, test, requirement, and finding identifiers all caused MV-011A and the assembly validator to fail.

Runtime generation now emits process-bound capability events and rejects an empty supplied ledger, ordinary hash tamper, PID mismatch, and nonce mismatch. However derivation accepts fully rehashed events with invalid terminal arithmetic or a registry-inconsistent reason, and MV-016A passes when the embedded provider event chain is removed while asserted summary rows and proof booleans remain. The package therefore does not independently substantiate the event-derived measurement claim.

The independent projector detects the prior meaning-loss probe and unexpected placeholders, does not retain the secret value in projection serialization, redacts bare Bearer, access_token, client_secret, and authorization-bearer forms, preserves near-miss names, and the frozen semantic records pass schema plus semantic validation.

Runtime controls correctly reject PPID, PGID, controlled-port, command-hash, executable, working-directory, nonce, and timestamp conflicts and send no signal when identity conflicts. However MV-016B accepts a forged packaged_command_line_sha256 and a forged packaged working directory, so the exported evidence is not independently checked for those claimed relationships.

findings.title: Provider event-chain assertions are not semantically rederived by package validation
evidence: A pure provider derivation probe rejected an empty fabricated zero ledger, an unrehashed event mutation, a PID mismatch, and a launch-nonce mismatch.

After recomputing the complete unkeyed event chain, derivation accepted a provider event with attempted=0 and every terminal outcome equal to zero, and separately accepted a reason_code that contradicted the source-controlled provider registry.

A detached assembly copy with every embedded foundation provider event removed, event_count set to zero, and the chain head set to zero still returned PASS 23/23; MV-014 and MV-016A both passed because asserted register rows and proof booleans were trusted instead of rederived.

The frozen Candidate 006 event chain itself is present, internally hash-consistent, and protected by its manifest; the finding concerns whether the candidate's validating control can independently substantiate that evidence before freeze.
findings.impact: A package can claim process-bound, hash-chained provider measurements while its underlying provider events are absent or semantically invalid. This retains the material provider/startup measurement blocker even though Candidate 006's immutable payload is unchanged.
findings.required_remediation: Require exact per-event schema, session identity, UTC, event type, boundary state, configuration state, reason code, source identity, value-handling flag, and one-terminal-state arithmetic; rederive and compare the complete event chain, provider register, proof, network-attempt totals, and duplicate exported provider artifacts. Add missing-event and fully rehashed semantic-mutation tests. Rebuild and freeze Candidate 007 for independent rereview.

findings.title: Packaged process-identity evidence accepts internally forged command and working-directory fields
evidence: Runtime _expected probes rejected PPID, PGID, port, command-hash, executable, working-directory, nonce, and future-timestamp conflicts.
A mocked _terminate conflict probe raised before signaling and os.killpg was not called.
Candidate 006 preserves both the pre-redaction command_line_sha256 and a packaged_command_line_sha256 over the path-redacted observed command; the frozen packaged hash is internally consistent.
A detached assembly mutation changed api_identity.packaged_command_line_sha256 to 64 zeroes; the validator returned PASS 23/23 and MV-016B passed.
A separate detached assembly mutation changed api_identity.working_directory to /forged/wrong/cwd; the validator again returned PASS 23/23 and MV-016B passed.
findings.impact: Runtime signaling is fail-closed, but the controlled package can still certify internally inconsistent process-identity evidence during assembly.
findings.required_remediation: Recompute packaged_command_line_sha256 from the path-redacted observed_command_line, validate the raw-hash-basis and path-redaction metadata plus all required identity value formats and relationships, cross-check startup and shutdown PID/PGID identities, and add packaged-evidence mutations for PPID, PGID, port, command, executable, working directory, nonce, and timestamp. Include the remediation in Candidate 007.
